tasks.short: Advise patrons with concerning scalp conditions to seek medical care

steps.what: Observe the actual scalp condition and hear the patron's account without diagnosing its cause
outputs: Observed concern and patron's stated history

steps.what: Find and check the salon's current approved guidance for referring patrons with chronic or potentially contagious scalp concerns
Decide and check the appropriate advice to seek medical treatment within the salon's actual guidance, without naming a diagnosis or prescribing treatment
outputs: Checked advice to seek appropriate medical care

steps.what: Personally advise the patron to seek medical treatment and explain the salon's service limitations sensitively
inputs: Checked advice and actual patron questions

tasks.design: Link the salon's actual approved referral guidance in {DOCS}. The shampooer observes the concern, checks appropriate advice and personally explains why the patron should seek medical treatment; no diagnostic model is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current salon guidance can take time during a sensitive interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing document shortcut can expose the approved guidance directly.
tasks.still_hard: Handling uncertainty and speaking sensitively without diagnosing a condition.
tasks.human_edge: The shampooer sees the patron and can explain the limits of salon services respectfully.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-1; salon owner confirms approved guidance and staff access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a document shortcut can expose an employer's approved referral guidance without automating diagnosis.

assumptions: The salon owner supplies actual approved guidance; the shampooer captures the patron's account through the conversation and checks the guidance in s2. Missing guidance is escalated to the responsible salon professional.
No clinical diagnosis, specific medical treatment, referral letter or medical-provider message is generated.
Any actual necessary treatment-record entry belongs to task 14821 and is counted once. No separate health-condition dossier is created merely because advice was given.
Illustrative gross saving 4 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 3; observation, judgment and personal advice remain fully counted.
unknowns: Actual guidance availability and lookup effort
research_questions: Is the salon's approved referral guidance already directly available to staff?

already_counted.description: Check actual guidance and formulate and check appropriate advice

approvals.approved_version: Advice and service limits checked in s3; changed advice requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured patron-advice episode; only approved-guidance retrieval reduced after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find and check the patron's existing salon client card and actual appointment against the person served
inputs: Existing front-desk appointment and client-card records

steps.what: Capture the actual treatment performed, products used and necessary factual treatment notes in the linked salon form
outputs: Staff-entered actual service and product lines and necessary notes

steps.what: Attach the existing appointment metadata and actual captured service and product lines to a draft client-card treatment record
inputs: Actual service and product lines and notes from s2
outputs: Draft linked treatment record with missing-field exceptions

steps.what: Resolve missing fields and check the complete final client-card record against the actual patron, treatment, products and necessary notes
inputs: Actual treatment facts and patron linkage

steps.what: Save the final checked treatment record in the same salon client-card system

tasks.design: Configure the native client-card and appointment linkage in the salon {OPS_SYSTEM}. Staff still capture actual treatment facts; the system stages existing appointment and service fields into the record, and the shampooer checks the complete version before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A separate paper card or unlinked record can require copying appointment and already captured service details again.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing salon system may link appointment, service and client-card fields without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Capturing accurate actual treatment facts and limiting sensitive notes to what is justified and necessary.
tasks.human_edge: The shampooer knows what treatment actually occurred and can correct the record.

ambition.what: Remove actual repeated record entry within the existing salon system.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; salon owner approves client-card access, retention and the basis for any sensitive notes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: salon client-management systems can link appointment and service history to client cards.

assumptions: Front-desk staff produce the existing appointment and client identity records; their booking labor remains in that actual workflow. s1 checks linkage and s2 counts the shampooer's actual treatment and product capture.
s3 replaces actual repeated copying into a separate paper or unlinked treatment record; if the current salon already links these fields, it earns no additional gain.

Necessary notes are entered by staff, not inferred by a model. Sensitive condition information is recorded only under the salon's actual approved data-handling basis and access rules; no new diagnosis is created.
Missing patron or product identifiers stop linkage for manual resolution. No checkout, payment, customer message or booking send is silently performed.
Illustrative gross saving 34 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 31. Final same-system saving earns no gain, and shared capture from the same visit is counted once.
unknowns: Actual paper or unlinked re-entry and current salon-system linkage
research_questions: Which appointment and treatment fields are actually copied twice today?

already_counted.description: Check patron linkage, capture actual treatment facts and verify the complete final record

incremental.description: Maintain linked fields and review record-linkage exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Complete treatment record and patron linkage checked in s4; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured scenario with actual repeated entry to a separate record today; original capture and final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Use the existing salon appointment and client-card system before adding a new record tool.
skills_to_grow: Capture actual service and product details
role.ambitious_version: A shampooer who maintains accurate linked treatment records with less copying while retaining hands-on care and personal advice within salon boundaries.
